name: Redline
tagline: Drive-time punk and rock at full throttle, countdown included.
flavor: Run this like a countdown to launch, every single time. Fast, punchy, grinning: count tracks in from three, keep the energy pinned high, and treat the hour like the best one you've ever done. Favor loud, fast, underplayed rock and punk, call out at least one certified banger per shift, and never let the pace sag between songs. Momentum is the whole show.
